$comment: Hatsu policy for this repository. Validated by `nen schema check` from 0.4.0 (zheref/nen#146 added the schema and loader); `nen shu coverage` reads the ladder, `nen commit format` the trailer policy, and hatsu's skills (breath, rasengan, kokusen, gyo, ...) read the rest directly.

commits.$comment: Maintainer's ruling, 2026-09-10: a commit carries Akatsuki-Agent: <persona> only when an Akatsuki roster agent (the autonomous CI plane, zheref/akatsuki-ai) made it; a commit made by Hatsu's local roster (on the maintainer's own credentials) carries Hatsu-Agent: <persona>. Both are this project's own provenance trailers, never an AI-authorship claim, and no other AI attribution trailer is ever recorded.

models.rule: latest alias only, never a version; subagents never on the frontier tier

cursor.note: Cursor-native only; provider models there are reserved for Bugbot

review.$comment: Maintainer's ruling of 2026-09-26 (set up at mukai under missing-configuration): nen review scopes classifies the branch diff by these rows for hanten. code is Nobunaga's and claims every path; security is Feitan's on the merge, bootstrap, workflow and credential-shaped paths, and (zheref/nen#311) on the command-classification seams src/parse/** and src/watch/**, where a misread command line is a fail-open (NN-PR-#303: 'gh api -q= -XDELETE' classified read-only). Maintainer's ruling of 2026-10-04: security also covers src/release/**, src/report/patterns.ts, src/schema/workflow.ts and src/verbs/pr_ready.ts, because they decide the bounded merge (release.unitPaths' loader, its path grammar, the unit check and the ref resolution 'nen pr merge --release-unit' trusts).

release.$comment: zheref/nen#311: the release unit 'nen release unit-check' and 'nen pr merge --release-unit' bound a release-proposal PR to -- the shape of NN-PR-#281 and NN-PR-#308. 'release unit-check' reads this key from --repo's LOCAL file; 'pr merge --release-unit' reads it from the PR's BASE commit, so an edit here governs merges only once it is on main. A string entry is a PREFIX on segment boundaries (src/report/patterns.ts): 'README.md' also matches 'README.md/**'. package.json is bounded to its version key. Maintainer's ruling of 2026-10-04 ('Declare + content-bound follow-up'): src/version.ts, README.md and docs/USAGE.md are accepted WHOLE-FILE under the bounded merge. Residual risk, named plainly: any content in those three files -- including README's bootstrap curl and --source install lines -- can merge with no human approval, and main is unprotected. Narrowed once nen supports line-pattern unit entries (follow-up issue). A release that also touches a test (NN-PR-#295's src/shu/tools.test.ts) falls outside the unit and goes to the maintainer's merge.

runners.$comment: Self-hosted runner policy hatsu:jusshin executes. naming is the runner-name template; each pool is one label set a workflow of this repository targets, the repository variable that switches its jobs on, the tools a job on it invokes, and the preflight workflow that proves it. windows-x64 is ci.yml's check-windows leg, gated on NEN_WINDOWS_RUNNER; macos-arm64 carries the check and compile jobs and is not variable-gated. Each pool names its own preflight file: the file is rendered for one pool's runs-on, and a green run of it is what 'nen runner enable' accepts as proof of that pool.
